summary: Frontend E2E verification of PM Command Center (Phase 4B). The /pm/command-center page renders cleanly with admin+PM tokens minted via /api/auth/multi-login. All 7 tabs mount, all 12 KPI tiles render real backend integers (NOT em-dashes), Road Plates tile cross-link works, PM scope guard works, legacy redirect works, iPad portrait/landscape have NO horizontal page-level scroll. Phase 4A backend endpoint /api/pm/command-center/overview returned HTTP 200 throughout.

integration_issues.issue: Selector pm-cc-hauls-fw-<row> returned count=0. Hauls panel itself mounts (data-testid=pm-cc-hauls) and shows 'FleetWatcher · Pending Integration' globally in the Integrations card on Overview, but per-row chips with the documented data-testid pattern were not found. Could be: (a) hauls API returned 0 rows at the moment of test, (b) testid is suffix-different (e.g. underscores vs hyphens), or (c) chip rendered without data-testid. Verify with main agent.

issues: Multiple data rows render summary/severity-occurred as em-dashes — this is honest data rendering for missing fields, not a bug. Worth confirming with PM that this is intended visual treatment vs. hiding empty cells.

action_items: Confirm whether Hauls per-row FleetWatcher chip should expose data-testid='pm-cc-hauls-fw-<truck>' (request spec) or if global Integrations chip is sufficient. If per-row required, add data-testid to PmHaulsBoard.jsx row chip.
